findings.evidence: src/app/api/plans/[planId]/items/route.ts line 53: `return NextResponse.json({ item }, { status: 201 });` - the POST handler's success response status code is grounded in the code, but the doc's Error Codes table (and the rest of the Key Endpoints section) only lists 400/401/404 and never states the 201 success status anywhere in the document.
findings.message: The POST /api/plans/{planId}/items success response status code (201, per `route.ts` line 53) is never documented; the Error Codes table and Response Example section cover only error statuses, silently omitting the success status.
